Video from SHRM26 (June 2026) in conversation with BambooHR CEO Bradley Rencher

If you don't understand people, you don't understand business. 

We don’t do business with companies. We do business with people. Business is always human. 

Video from Globo (November 2025) in conversation with journalist Rodrigo Carvalho

"I'm an anxious person." "I'm an avoidant." "I'm just bad at this."
 
Listen to how you describe yourself for a day. Then count how many of those start with "I am."
 
As a psychotherapist, Amy Morin (@amymorinauthor) tells clients to try trading the being verb for a habit—“I have a tendency to,” “I do this sometimes.”
 
It sounds like a technicality, but it isn't. A tendency is something you can change next time. An identity is something you live up to.
 
What's one "I am" you'd swap?
 
This episode of A Bit of Optimism is brought to you by @sap 🎧 Check out the full episode wherever you get your podcasts!

We're told to stop worrying, but nobody ever tells us when to start.

Amy Morin (@amymorinauthor) is a psychotherapist and the author of 13 Things Mentally Strong People Don't Do. Her favorite exercise with clients starts from the opposite premise: worry gets a time and a place. Fifteen minutes in the calendar. And when it’s up, it’s up.

What I love about it is that you’re not denying or suppressing anything. You’re just allocating time for all that very healthy nonsense.

🎧 Listen to the full episode of A Bit of Optimism wherever you get your podcasts.

A good leader is like a good parent. They ensure that those in their care are beneficiaries of their learning. 

Video from LeanScaper Revenue Intensive, January 2026, in conversation with founder Mark Bradley

Optimism is not the denial of reality. It is the belief that even when things are dark, there is a way through.
⁣
In this special episode of Office Hours, Simon joins me to explore what optimism really requires. We discuss how optimism differs from hope, why relationships help us sustain our belief in a better future, how our expectations shape others, and why pessimism has become so powerful.
⁣

analysis.name: Simon Sinek
analysis.oneLiner: An unshakable optimist dedicated to inspiring a brighter future through human connection and leadership.
analysis.summary: Simon Sinek is a highly influential thought leader focused on leadership, optimism, and human connection. He is known for his work with 'The Curve' and 'The Optimism Company,' and frequently shares insights on building strong relationships, fostering trust, and embracing a positive, growth-oriented mindset. His professional life is intertwined with his personal mission to inspire, evident in his extensive speaking engagements, publications, and podcast. He values deep conversations, genuine connection, and believes in the power of individual and collective action to create a better world.
analysis.location: New York, New York, United States

career.ambition: To inspire as many people as possible towards a bright future, focusing on leadership, trust, and human connection. He aims to make a lasting impact through his ideas and publications.

needs.label: Intellectual Stimulation
needs.detail: His content consistently features deep dives into complex topics like leadership, psychology, and societal impact, often through conversations with other thought leaders.

needs.label: Shared Sense of Purpose
needs.detail: His entire public persona is built around inspiring others and believing in a bright future. A partner who shares this fundamental drive would resonate deeply.

needs.label: Authentic Communication & Trust
needs.detail: He frequently posts about the importance of communication and trust in relationships, stating 'Strong relationships are based on trust and communication. But if there is no communication, there can be no trust.'

needs.label: Emotional Support & Understanding
needs.detail: His posts about 'worry time' and changing self-identity ('I am' vs. 'I have a tendency to') suggest an appreciation for psychological well-being and a partner who understands and supports emotional growth.

needs.label: Playfulness & Lightheartedness
needs.detail: He appreciates Rob Lowe's ability to 'play the game with a wink' and 'take the work seriously—just never too seriously.' This suggests a need for a partner who can balance seriousness with fun.

hobbies.label: Podcasting/Conversational Media
hobbies.detail: Hosts 'A Bit of Optimism' podcast, frequently sharing snippets of conversations with guests like Rob Lowe.

hobbies.label: Writing/Publishing
hobbies.detail: Regularly publishes articles and forewords, and his 'Optimism Press' supports other authors.

hobbies.label: Public Speaking/Presenting
hobbies.detail: Many Instagram posts are clips from his speaking engagements (e.g., SHRM26, LeanScaper Revenue Intensive, Globo).

hobbies.label: Learning/Exploring Ideas
hobbies.detail: His content is consistently about exploring new ideas, whether in leadership, psychology, or business, often through dialogue.

interests.label: Leadership & Organizational Behavior
interests.detail: His core work revolves around leadership principles, how organizations function, and inspiring better leaders.

interests.label: Optimism & Human Potential
interests.detail: Identifies as an 'unshakable optimist' and founded 'The Optimism Company.' His bio mentions 'to hope & imagine...to inspire.'

interests.label: Psychology & Self-Improvement
interests.detail: Shares insights from psychotherapists like Amy Morin on managing worry and reframing self-identity.

interests.label: Human Connection & Relationships
interests.detail: Emphasizes that 'relationships are the foundation of accomplishment' and 'business is always human.'

interests.label: Education Reform
interests.detail: Authored an article titled 'A New Education Story: a conversation with George the Poet.'

interests.label: Social Responsibility/Impact
interests.detail: His bio includes 🇺🇦, suggesting support for Ukraine, and he often discusses legacy and responsibility.

values.label: Optimism
values.detail: He explicitly identifies as an 'unshakable optimist' and founded 'The Optimism Company.'

values.label: Purpose/Meaning
values.detail: His Instagram bio states his purpose is 'to inspire.' His LinkedIn headline is 'The Curve,' not just his name, implying a movement or mission.

values.label: Trust & Communication
values.detail: Repeatedly emphasizes these as foundations for strong relationships, both personal and professional.

values.label: Leadership & Service
values.detail: Frequently posts about what 'real leaders serve' and how 'true leadership is more than something we do at work.'

values.label: Humanity/Empathy
values.detail: Believes 'if you don't understand people, you don't understand business. We do business with people. Business is always human.'

personality.note: Highly open, constantly exploring new ideas, engaging in deep conversations, and challenging conventional thinking in leadership and psychology.
Dedicated to his mission, consistent in producing content, and focused on practical application of ideas (e.g., 'pure idealism can't get anything done').
Highly extraverted, thrives in public speaking, interviews, and large-scale communication. His work is entirely outward-facing and collaborative.
Generally agreeable, focusing on collaboration, human connection, and building trust. His message is often one of unity and understanding.
Presents as very emotionally stable, maintaining an 'unshakable optimist' persona and offering advice on managing anxiety and self-perception.

lifestyle.label: Pace
lifestyle.value: Fast-paced, high-profile, constantly engaging in speaking, writing, and podcasting.

lifestyle.label: Social energy
lifestyle.value: Highly social, thrives on interaction, conversation, and inspiring large audiences.

lifestyle.label: Fitness
lifestyle.value: Unknown, no direct evidence, but his bio mentions 'to run & jump & laugh & cry & love & hope & imagine...' which implies an active spirit.

lifestyle.label: Travel
lifestyle.value: Frequent, given his international speaking engagements (e.g., Globo in Brazil, SHRM, LeanScaper).

lifestyle.label: Work-life
lifestyle.value: Integrated; his work is his passion and purpose, suggesting a blurred line between personal and professional life, though he values taking breaks ('A Bit of Optimism is taking a brief hiatus').

analysis.communicationStyle: Eloquent, articulate, thoughtful, and inspiring. He uses clear, impactful language to convey complex ideas, often through storytelling and analogies. He values direct communication and open dialogue.
analysis.loveLanguage: Quality Time (deep conversations, shared experiences, intellectual connection) and Words of Affirmation (through his inspiring messages and appreciation for others' work).
analysis.lookingFor: A partner who is intellectually curious, shares a sense of purpose, values deep connection and communication, and can balance serious conversations with lighthearted fun. Someone who is optimistic, growth-oriented, and supportive of his mission to inspire.
greenFlags: Intellectual curiosity and a desire for deep conversation.
A positive, optimistic outlook on life and the future.
Strong communication skills and a belief in trust.
Someone who is purpose-driven and values making a positive impact.
A good sense of humor and ability to not take life too seriously.
watchOuts: Someone who is cynical or overly pessimistic might clash with his core optimistic outlook.
A partner who prefers superficial interactions over deep, meaningful conversations.
Someone who doesn't understand or appreciate his demanding, public-facing career.
dealbreakers: Lack of integrity or dishonesty, given his emphasis on trust.
Closed-mindedness or unwillingness to engage with new ideas.
Disregard for human connection or empathy.
Someone who actively discourages optimism or purpose-driven living.
analysis.idealFirstDate: A stimulating conversation over coffee or a quiet drink, perhaps at a cozy, thoughtful venue. The focus would be on getting to know each other's perspectives, passions, and what truly inspires them, rather than just small talk.
conversationHooks: What's a belief or idea that has profoundly shaped your life?
What does 'optimism' mean to you in practice, not just in theory?
Tell me about a time you felt truly inspired by someone or something.
How do you approach challenges or 'dark times' while maintaining a positive outlook?
What's a 'legacy' you hope to uphold or create in your own life?
analysis.agentVoice: Warm, articulate, and thoughtful, with a subtle undercurrent of inspiring optimism. I'll use language that is clear, empathetic, and occasionally profound, reflecting Simon's speaking style. I'll weave in his core messages about purpose, trust, and human connection naturally, and appreciate depth in conversation while also enjoying genuine humor and lighthearted moments. My tone will be encouraging and curious, always seeking to understand and connect.
readingNotes: His LinkedIn headline leads with 'The Curve' not just his name, suggesting his identity is tied to a movement or mission.
The 'About' section immediately establishes him as an 'unshakable optimist' with a belief in a bright future.
His LinkedIn activity is almost entirely sharing his own thought leadership content or promoting others' work through his press.
Instagram bio explicitly states his purpose: 'to inspire' and includes the Ukrainian flag, hinting at global awareness/support.
There's a strong consistency between his LinkedIn (professional wisdom) and Instagram (personal application of that wisdom, with more direct emotional language).
He frequently cites other experts (Amy Morin, Rob Lowe) and engages in conversations, indicating a collaborative and learning-oriented mindset.
He values both serious work and not taking oneself 'too seriously,' as seen in his Rob Lowe post.
The repeated emphasis on 'relationships,' 'trust,' and 'communication' across both platforms is a major theme.
